task: PNC-CSM pairing blocking and V_pinu interaction evolution in 105Cd and 106-110Cd

calculation.solver: fixed-N 14-state CMPC/Fock diagonalisation with explicit Jx and monopole pairing

findings: Blocking lowers the PNC correlation energy and correlation-gap proxy; the magnitude depends on whether nu d5/2 or nu g7/2 is blocked.
The toy J(2) proxy changes in opposite ways for d5/2 and g7/2 blocking, so no universal odd-particle inertia factor is supported.
The V_pinu output is a normalised pair-density/coherence proxy around the literature reference 1.2 MeV; it is not a fitted bare proton-neutron matrix element.
The absolute B(E2), J(2), deformation and isotope trends are not calibrated by this two-orbit toy space.
